mentions.text: It feels like every time there's a mathematics post on the front page I post a video by Matt Parker. This time, here's a video that explains from the basics what kinds of numbers exist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5TkIe60y2GI

mentions.author: jerf
mentions.text: It's worse than you make it sound, though: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5TkIe60y2GI In short, it isn't just that we have more computables than non-computables; there are categories of numbers  …
